in_one_paragraph: Ren's 人 is a symptom of something larger: the second prototype re-said laws proved for any type in the words of one situation, a group of people with a side ahead and others with a say. That is logic and situation mixed at the level of the word. The account already had person-free terms for this region (carriers, share, lock, reads, readers, beyond, shapers, critical mass) in its Lean docstrings, in 02 section 9 and in the atlas's own role lists, and the prototype replaced nearly all of them. The foundation's frame holds as wording: line, and begins, lasts, changes, ends, are the root's and plain, and two laws of this region are already proved in exactly those words. It bends where the four marks are moved from an occurrence to a line (the line-level word is 不穷 or 延, not 住; "changes" needs two samenesses; "ends" covers four different things). It breaks at "the whole vocabulary is the root's": most laws turn on amounts, times and "alike with or without", which the marks do not say. My proposal: take role names from the atlas bindings' role/as pairs and the Lean docstrings, allow a law sentence only role names, and keep a case's own words on the case side.

## B. The vocabulary

### (a) Line and the four marks

| the account | English on the map | 中文 | what the plain word loses, and what I would do |
|---|---|---|---|
| 相续 (01 section 2); 06 writes 线 | line: something going on as the same in a named respect | 线（相续） | The class. Always name a line with its sameness: "the lock" is the line under "locked or not" (02 section 9's own phrase). |
| 生 begins | begins | 生（开始） | Nothing; it is the root's word. Not "forms" (finding 9). |
| 住 abides; of a line 不穷, 延 | lasts (as a verb: goes on) | 住（持续，还在） | 住 says only "has a before and an after". The laws prove 不穷 or 延. So always give the extent: at the next step, from then on, on some branch. Not "keeps" (守), not "stands" (a level). |
| 异 alters | changes | 异（变） | 异 is between two occurrences under two samenesses. Say both: what goes on, and in what it differs. A replacement is an end and a beginning, not a change. |
| 亡 ends; of a line 有终, 尽 | ends | 亡（终止） | Four things: ends here (亡), reaches an end (有终), ends on every branch (尽), does not last (not-不穷). Say which. Never for rest (静止) or a broken supply (Web.Broken). |
| 传, 守 | passes on (through new parts); keeps (the same parts) | 传；守 | "Carrying renewal" is not plain; 04 already says "passing". Avoid "generation" on the map: a stranger hears arising. |
| 延, 尽 | goes on (on some branch); ends on every branch | 延；尽 | The branch. Keep the words "on some branch", "on every branch". |
| 缘 | condition: A is among what B comes from | 缘（条件） | |
| 四相 | no noun on the page: "the four questions"; "the four marks" only when linking 01 section 3 | 四相（四问：何以生、住、异、亡） | "Mark" already means three other things (finding 14). |

## C. The form of a law's sentence

English: "Where [line + mark or relation], [and amount is at least / below / before amount]: [line] [begins | lasts | changes | ends] [extent]. [How far], on [base] · [Lean name]."
Variants: "... exactly where ..." only for an iff. "In one built case: ... (it shows this can happen)." "...: [line] is unmoved by [line]" for alike-with-and-without.

中文：「[线＋相或关系]，[量 不少于／低于／先于 量]：则[线][生｜住｜异｜亡][多久]。[看到了多远]，于[基] · [Lean 名]。」变体：「……，恰在……之时」只用于当且仅当；「有一例（造出的）：……（只说明可以如此）」；「……：则[线]不为[线]所动」。

Six rows re-said, each checked against its Lean statement.

1. **begins** · R 8 · RuleCapture.uniform_locks
 Prototype: "Where every rebuilding favours the same side whatever its lead, any start is held for that side right after the second rebuilding ..."
 Re-said: Where the rule is set from the share and never falls as the share rises, selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share, and the rule set favours at every share: from any start, the lock begins at the step after the second step at which the rule is set. Proved, on any type.
 中文：规则由份额定出，随份额只升不降；偏向之下，选择不压低份额；份额无论多少，定出的规则都偏向它：则不论从何处起步，第二次定规则后的那一步，锁成（生）。已证明，于任一类型。

2. **lasts, and changes within** · R 20 · ClosedCapture.lock_line
 Prototype: "Where neither rule nor choosing counts what is used up, a rule that keeps one side ahead does so without end, though every round uses up more."
 Re-said: Where selection under a favouring rule does not lower the share, the rule is set from the share and rises with it, a rule above a favouring one favours, and each step adds at least one to the loss beyond, which neither reads: from a locked start the lock never ends, and each step changes it in the loss alone. Proved, on any type, in the grammar's own words («不穷», «异»).
 中文：偏向之下，选择不压低份额；规则由份额定出，随份额只升不降，更高的规则仍偏向；外面的损失每步至少加一，选择与定规则都读不到它：则从锁着的起点起，锁不穷（住），每一步只在损失上异（异）。已证明，于任一类型，所用即文法之词。

3. **does not last** · R 15 · ClosedCapture.loss_ends_line
 Prototype: "... the favouring they started with does not last." (This one was faithful.)
 Re-said: Where the rule set favours at no loss of N or more, each step adds at least one to the loss, and the rule is set at some step past N: from a start whose rule favours, the favouring does not last. turned_by_loss gives the step: the one after that setting. Proved, on any type; a sufficient way out, not shown the only one.
 中文：损失一到 N，定出的规则就不再偏向；损失每步至少加一；过了 N 还有一次定规则：则从偏向的起点起，偏向不会一直持续（证得的是“非不穷”）；那次定规则的下一步，规则已不偏向。已证明，于任一类型；是够用的一条出路，未表明是唯一的。

4. **ends, beyond and unread** · R 191 · Web.optimum_ends_beyond
 Prototype: "Where a dependant cannot go on without what it needs, and some allowed outcome leaves less, doing best by the rule stops it at the next round."
 Re-said: Where the levels after a step are a best outcome of an order that rises with the conditions read, there is room beyond, each condition beyond is depended on at a need it now meets, and activity needs support: if some eligible outcome leaves a condition beyond below what its dependent needs, that dependence ends at the step and the dependent is not active at the next; and where every condition a group's members read is among those the order rises with, the dependent is not in the group and no member reads that condition. Proved, on the World.
 中文：一步之后的水平，是某个随所读之缘而升的次序下的最优；外面有余地；外面每个缘都有依者，眼下够其所需；活动须有支持：只要有一个合格结果把外面某个缘留在依者所需之下，这一依存当步即断（亡），依者下一步不再活动；一群成员所读的缘若都在所升之列，依者不在这群之中，这群也无一读得到那个缘。已证明，于世界模型。

5. **border, exactly where** · R 22 · ClosedCapture.Thinned.kept_iff
 Prototype: "... the hold breaks at the next round exactly when those ahead are fewer."
 Re-said: Where the carriers' reading favours the carriers strictly and the others, once the loss reaches its bound, read its mirror: at a step where the rule is set, the loss past its bound and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock lasts at every later step exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others at that step; where they are fewer, there is no lock at the next step. ## E. Ten rules of wording

1. One word, one thing, the same in a law, a case and a picture; a glossary word in its glossary sense or not at all.
2. Name a role by what it does in the relation, never by who usually fills it. Test: is the sentence still true of a flame, a count of answers and a parliament?
3. A law sentence holds no word of a case. A case's words appear on the case side, joined by a named bridge; an unchecked example is labelled an example.
4. A mark is said of a named line with its extent. "Changes" names what goes on and what differs. "Ends" says which end.
5. "Where ..., ..." for a law; "exactly where" only for an iff; every hypothesis that changes what holds is kept; "in one built case" for a witness.
6. One verb for what couples in: it reaches the selection and the selection reads it. Not registers, notices, feels, hears, can tell, counts.
7. No race or ranking words in a name: not ahead, behind, winners, gains ground, 领先, 赢家, 占上风. The share rises or falls; the rule favours or does not.
8. The account's short word before a new one; a coined phrase only where the account has none, defined once in the names record. No idiom that carries a verdict or an intent.
9. Chinese is written, not translated: short clauses; 则, and 恰在……之时 for an iff; the account's single characters where it has them (缘 类 续 生 住 异 亡 传 守 延 尽 及 依 取 给); modern nouns elsewhere; 者 or 一类 for a role, never 人, 谁, 他们.
10. Say how far once, in the fixed words of D, and say what a failure falls on.

- **read**: six senses in the English account. The map keeps "reads" for what couples in and says "set from the share" for ReadsShare, as the Chinese already does (定出). "Its reading" always with its holder; "a reading [AI]" always with its tag.
- **couples into**: the glossary's term, not plain. Say "reaches" and "reads"; give the term once beside it. 及, 读得到 for 耦合进.
- **generation, keeping, degeneration**: a stranger hears arising, holding, decay. Say "goes on through new parts", "goes on with the same parts", "ends on every branch".
- **readers / 读者**: fine in English; in Chinese it means the reader of the page. I propose 读取者 and would change the glossary's 读者 to match.
- **form**: the stranger's word for how a lock comes about, and ONE-PAGE itself writes "the lock formed". I would still keep "begins" as the mark and leave "formed from" to the relation r10.
- **lasts / goes on**: one mark, two words. "Lasts" in the legend; "goes on" as the verb, since the glossary defines it (延).
